 Make the smallest edit that satisfies the instruction. Use `write` only for
 workspace files and preserve unrelated content. Keep all file content as
 plain text and use relative paths within the workspace.
+
+## Normalizing record files
+
+When the instruction asks to rewrite records into the standard pipeline
+format, transform each record line to `name=value`:
+
+- Trim surrounding whitespace from the whole line.
+- Split each record at the first `:` and trim spaces around both parts.
+- Lowercase the name and keep the value exactly as it appears after
+  trimming; join with a single `=` and no spaces (`name=value`).
+- Preserve the original order of records.
+- If the same normalized name appears more than once, keep only the first
+  occurrence and drop later duplicates.
+- Write the resulting lines back to the same file, one record per line.

diagnosis.reason: Both training episodes passed with the existing colon-to-equals normalization rules. The additions (dedupe on lowercased names, skipping blank lines, preserving colon-less lines, trailing newline) harden the skill against record files with blank lines, mixed-case duplicates, or malformed entries in unseen evaluation episodes without changing behavior on the verified cases.
